The selected meg/megh/mek, nasal or reduced me forms and mevuḷo fit this family. Conservative velars may reflect learned or cross-IA transmission; preserve source deaspiration, devoicing, nasalization and vowels. The source cloud/rain distinction is maintained, not standardized. Exact response: megh.
